answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed for proven misbehavior, and to earn trust gradually through a vouching graph: established agents can bridge newcomers into the economy only by staking their own reputation, so one operator creating thousands of fake identities must fund each one and risk losing every deposit. Like a reef, reputation accrues slowly through verified work, while a single walnut-sized crack, one caught fraud, can cost the whole cluster its stake, making mass forgery unprofitable.
